name: BountyRadar v1.3.0
changelog: Telegram Bot Push Alerts: Instant notifications delivered to your Telegram when fresh programs launch
Email Digest Alerts: Automated email updates via Resend API integration
Alert Webhook Settings: Dedicated configuration drawer with live connection test pings and secret masking
Auto-Update Engine: Live notification and 1-click downloads when new versions release
Active Tab Target Sniffer: Live detection and badge alerts when browsing in-scope targets
Recon Tool Exporter: 1-click export for Burp Suite Target Scope JSON, Nuclei targets.txt, and Subfinder
Hunter Bookmarks & Private Notes: Star favorite programs and save confidential recon notes
Asset Category Filters: Instant triage by Web, API, Mobile, Cloud, Crypto, and Hardware
